---
title: "News"
listing:
  id: news-posts
  contents: posts
  sort: "date desc"
  type: default
  # Without `image`, Quarto does not keep an empty thumbnail column.
  fields: [date, title, subtitle, description, categories]
  categories: true
  sort-ui: false
  filter-ui: false
  feed: true
# Quarto loads MathJax on every listing page. The listing shows no maths.
html-math-method: plain
include-after-body:
  - category-pills.html
---

```{=html}
<button type="button" id="news-clear-category" class="listing-category" disabled>Clear category filter</button>
```
